text:
maria-partnerships: Quick FYI — starting cloud marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure for the Q2 listing. Need a short sync on legal artifacts, packaging, and preflight tests.
alex-product: thanks. main question: are we shipping trial seats (3-user trial) or a time-limited trial token? affects SKU + pricing metadata.
laura-legal: prefer time-limited trial + EULA clause; easier for EU privacy. we'll need localized EULA and VAT fields for EU regions.
jordan-engineering: for deployment assets: do we provide AMI + container, or just container image + deployment script? Also need a test account that can pull private images (registry access)
sam-ops: staging creds for publisher portal ready. I'll also provision a sandbox tenant for billing test. Need guidance on KMS (BYOK) requirement from legal.
laura-legal: BYOK optional but include docs. Add line: "Customer-managed keys are supported via KMS/HSM — see security addendum." We'll send template CLA + localized EULA drafts by EOD.
alex-product: packaging question — single SKU with metered seats vs tiered bundles? If metered we'll need usage metering hooks and sample payload for the marketplace metering API.
maria-partnerships: let's default to tiered bundles (Starter/Pro/Enterprise) with a 14-day trial token option. Alex, can you draft the pricing metadata and SKU IDs? use naming: redwood-starter, redwood-pro, redwood-enterprise
alex-product: will do. Also need a short hero blurb and 2 screenshots (console + api sample). Can design team drop 1200x600 hero and 800x450 screenshot assets?
marketplace-bot: Workspace workflow created: marketplace-onboard-4987654321. Assign/track tasks at https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/MP-512
jordan-engineering: technical checklist: 1) asset manifest (logo, screenshots, support contact) 2) deployment artifact (container + helm chart) 3) quickstart scripts 4) access test accounts 5) metering webhook endpoint
sam-ops: I'll run billing smoke tests once we have SKU IDs and sandbox creds. Ping me when assets are uploaded to staging bucket.
maria-partnerships: action items: Laura -> EULA + CLA templates; Alex -> SKU metadata, blurb, screenshots; Jordan -> artifact list + helm chart; Sam -> billing test plan. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar: 
alex-product: noted. I'll drop initial SKU json snippet here:

```
{
  "sku": "redwood-pro",
  "price": "299/month",
  "trial": "14d_time_limited",
  "metering": "tiered"
}
```

laura-legal: FYI include support email and DPA link in listing metadata.
maria-partnerships: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll create the publisher portal entry and add links once artifacts land. :thumbsup:
